findings.text: Stack argument preparation accepts a binprm descriptor plus a stack top and an executable stack request, and finalizes the temporary argument mapping into its permanent stack placement while adjusting recorded argument pointers and limits. It reports resource, interruption and fault conditions to its caller.

Exec transition entry validates pending loader state, derives credentials, marks an irreversible point, collapses threading, replaces address space and signal state, installs identity and credentials, and hands an interpreter file descriptor back when present. It returns zero on commitment and negative status otherwise.

After segment loading the memory descriptor records code span, data span, stack origin derived from the binprm pointer, and break range derived from the highest loadable extent with page rounding and optional randomization moves. Interpretation of entry and header addresses includes the applied load displacement.

Argument stack setup maintains correspondence between the binprm current pointer, execution pointer, argument start in the memory descriptor, and the stack virtual area bounds across a downward shift, preserving length while relocating to the aligned top.

Loadable extents are accepted only when file size does not exceed memory size, both fit within the task limit without wrap, and the translated address is considered valid. Violation abandons loading with an invalid argument status and releases interpreter and header resources.

Final stack extent respects configured address minimum, maximum stack reservation with randomization allowance on upward growth, and current limit masked to page granularity. Oversize or underflow requests fail before mutation with a memory status.

Exec proceeds only after the invoking thread becomes the sole survivor of its group and, when necessary, assumes the former leader identity including timing, group linkage and parent notification semantics. Concurrent group exit or fatal pending signal aborts with a retry status.

Once credentials are derived and the no-return marker is set, later failures remain fatal and cleanup follows the exec path rather than returning to the old image. Close on exec, executable file installation, dumpability, namespace, signal and credential installation observe a fixed ordering around address space replacement.

Argument page accounting has two builds. One maintains a running anon page count by delta against the binprm record, the other performs no accounting. Both ignore empty descriptors or zero deltas in effect.

Stack finalization holds the memory descriptor write lock in killable form across permission update, relocation and expansion, releasing it on all exits. Translation gathering brackets only the permission phase and iteration starts from the stack area base.

Exec address space replacement and thread collapse serialize through the signal update lock in write mode, the old address read lock, task lock with interrupt masking around active context switch, signal spinlock with interrupt save, tasklist lock for identity exchange, and credential guard until new credentials commit. Each is released on its failure path.

Position independent loading selects displacement differently for interpreter versus standalone images and for large alignment requests, combining a fixed dynamic base, architecture randomization when the process allows it, and alignment masking with collision resistant mapping. The first loadable extent may refine the bias from the actual placement.

Break initialization starts from the highest loaded extent, then optionally relocates standalone randomized dynamic images to the dynamic base region and optionally applies architecture randomization with a gap, tracking whether movement occurred for later randomization bookkeeping unless compatibility mode forbids moves.

Memory switching allocates replacement execution state, releases old futex interest, installs the new descriptor under locks with cache, identifier and generation updates, activates the new context, then defers old teardown to a later phase while completing futex handover.

Failure modes use distinct negative statuses for invalid images, missing resources, interrupted locks, retryable group contention and unconsumable loader state, with interpreter references, header allocations and write access consistently unwound and address validity rechecked after interpreter and entry computation.

Compatibility and policy edges include optional read execute mapping of page zero under a personality request with sealing on success, one time warning when the final stack remains executable, and secure execution clamping of inherited stack limits before layout selection.

Loading relies on stable ABI names including ELF_ET_DYN_BASE and ELF_MIN_ALIGN and PF_X and MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE and PF_RANDOMIZE and MMAP_PAGE_ZERO with compatibility and architecture randomization controls. Each denotes a fixed value whose layout effect is observed here but whose definition lives elsewhere.

Stack and exec control rely on stable ABI names including VM_STACK_FLAGS and VM_EXEC and VM_STACK_INCOMPLETE_SETUP and EXSTACK_ENABLE_X and EXSTACK_DISABLE_X and TASK_KILLABLE and TASK_DUMPABLE_OWNER with stack limit and dumpability controls. Each denotes a fixed value referenced by the cited fragments.
